title: Inside Limoges City Hall devastated by arson attack

contentText: Work is underway to restore the city hall of Limoges, in central France, which was devastated by an arson attack during riots on October 17. More than €1.7 million has been raised through an online fundraising campaign in the wake of the disaster. Also on the show, the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI has finally been released, with gamers in Oceania among the first to get a taste of the latest instalment in the video game franchise.
